prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a single transparent PNG sprite for a 2D animated eye rig. Reference image: the supplied full-body cat-eared anime woman, use her ANATOMICAL LEFT eye (on the viewer's RIGHT) as the exact design reference. Generate ONLY this single eye's sclera and black upper/lower lash outline, enlarged, on a truly transparent background. Remove iris and pupil completely and reconstruct the white sclera behind them, with subtle pale warm-gray shading at the top. No skin, no eyebrow, no hair, no second eye, no text, no checkerboard pattern. Preserve the reference's angular almond silhouette, tapered inner corner on image LEFT, outer corner/lash flick on image RIGHT, bold black upper lashes, delicate lower rim, hand-painted cel-shaded anime style. 1024x1024 square canvas. Eye corners at approximately (180,520) inner and (844,490) outer, upper middle at (510,350), lower middle at (510,690). Keep the entire eye inside this bounding box, transparent padding around it. This is an actual reusable sclera-and-outline sprite, not an illustration of a sprite sheet.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent isolated iris-and-pupil sprite for an anime eye rig. Reference: supplied cat-eared woman, her anatomical LEFT eye on viewer RIGHT. Reproduce ONLY the complete golden amber iris, black oval pupil, dark brown outer iris rim and the original white highlights, reconstructing the upper area hidden by eyelid. An upright complete round-to-slightly-vertical-oval iris, centered on a square canvas with ample genuinely TRANSPARENT padding. No sclera, no eyelids, no lashes, no skin, no hair, no text or checkerboard. Hand-painted cel-shaded anime style faithful to reference, dark brown at top graduating to warm gold at bottom, restrained original highlights. Iris bounding box approximately x320..704 y260..764 on 1024x1024. Fully opaque iris interior, smoothly antialiased transparent edge. This is a reusable sprite that will move independently behind an eyelid mask.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one transparent closed-eyelid / eyelash sprite for a 2D anime avatar rig. Reference: cat-eared woman supplied, ANATOMICAL LEFT eye (viewer RIGHT). Draw ONLY a single gently closed upper eyelid and its black eyelashes, no eyeball, no iris, no sclera, no skin patch, no eyebrow, no hair. Match her black tapered anime lash brushwork. A slender gently curved single closed-eye stroke, inner corner at image LEFT tapering finely, outer corner at image RIGHT with her modest pointed lashes. A relaxed closed eye, not exaggerated happy upward arch. Center the single horizontal eye stroke on a 1024x1024 truly TRANSPARENT canvas, spanning approximately x180..844 and y480..560, lots of transparent padding. NO second eye, no text, no checkerboard, no surrounding illustration. Opaque black/brown painted lash, antialiased alpha edge. Intended to replace the aperture only at full blink in a layered rig.
